label: Brc23 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a gcu23/Brc23 bacteriophage-resistance integron cassette that supports growth during bacteriophage challenge.
observations: Brc23 branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Brc23 proteins, brc23 nucleotide sequences, attC sites, absent source database rows naming gcu23, absent DefenseFinder HMM/rules profiles, broad BRiC families, Brc22/Tragantia homolog-family scope, and other mobile integron phage-defense cassettes.
